I have only a small piece of land for sorghum, and my money is not enough to buy chemical fertilizer for this plot when I also need to feed my family. I will use manure from my animals to give the soil some strength, and my wife and children will help me with the planting, weeding, and harvesting so I do not need to hire anyone. We always keep our own sorghum seed from last year, and since the rains usually come in Zomba, I will not irrigate or spend money on chemicals.
